messages:
jess: heads up — deploy-bot failed to publish image to ECR eu-west-1 for release/2026-03-20-build847. Error says provenance annotation mismatch. I saw the push log attached from CI.

deploy-bot: publish rejected: PutImage API returned 400. reason=provenance:annotation.platform != manifest.platform (expected \"amd64\", found \"arm64\"). build_id=20260320-847 sha=sha256:abcd1234

omar: ugh. that was built on one of the arm builders. CI should have produced a multi-arch manifest but looks like our publish step flattened to the arm manifest only.

lina: quick check — was `docker buildx` used with `--platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64`? CI job 847 shows `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build` not buildx. that explains the missing manifest list.

jess: ah, we switched a runner pool to the new arm image to speed up deps, forgot to enable buildx for multi-arch. my bad.

release-manager: we need to pause the EU canary rollout until this is fixed. change window patch scheduled for 30m from now but let's hold. can we pin the canary to the previous image tag to avoid a bad deploy? @sre-oncall any objections?

sre-oncall: yes please pin. I'll apply an emergency patch to the k8s canary deployment to image: `registry.redwood.ai/service:v20260319-782` and set rollout strategy to paused. will monitor for any traffic anomalies.

omar: plan: 1) rebuild with buildx on linux/amd64+arm64 2) push multi-arch manifest using `docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --push -t registry.redwood.ai/service:v20260320-847 .` 3) ensure provenance annotations include `build.platforms=[amd64,arm64]` 4) retry publish via deploy-bot.

jess: doing a rebuild now on the amd64 pool. will paste the buildx invocation and manifest inspect once done.

jess: (after rebuild) pushed with buildx. manifest inspect shows both platforms:```
{
  "manifests": [
    {"platform": {"architecture": "amd64", "os": "linux"}},
    {"platform": {"architecture": "arm64", "os": "linux"}}
  ]
}
```

deploy-bot: attempting publish retry for sha=sha256:abcd1234 tag=v20260320-847 in eu-west-1

deploy-bot: publish accepted. provenance attached. note: regional attestation digest changed (was sha256:abcd1234, now sha256:efgh5678) due to manifest list normalization.

omar: thanks. important note — because the attestation digest changed, any existing pin by digest in repos will not match. we should avoid digest pins in short-term release notes unless we have a promotion step that copies digests.

release-manager: documented in release notes: "Fix: multi-arch manifest push for service; image retagged and republished. EU canary was paused and pinned to previous tag during remediation." adding a follow-up task to add CI guard to require multi-arch builds for this repo.

lina: created PR https://git.internal/redwood/infra-ci/pull/412 to add a lint that fails if `buildx` isn't used for images that declare multiple platforms.

jess: thanks all. closing the immediate issue. leaving the pause until SRE confirms stable. :white_check_mark:
